name: family-app
description: Family AI Agent with MCP Server Integration

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start:all
scripts.build: npm run build:agent && npm run build:api
scripts.start:all: start "Agent API" cmd /k "cd agent-api && yarn start" && timeout /t 3 && start "Family UI" cmd /k "cd family-agent-ui && yarn start"
scripts.stop: taskkill /F /IM node.exe /T 2>nul || echo No Node.js processes found
